## Frequently asked questions

Discover answers to some of the most-asked questions about our platform.

![](https://active-campaign.transforms.svdcdn.com/production/general/AC-Collage-1.png?w=1920&h=1920&q=80&auto=format&fit=crop&crop=focalpoint&fp-x=0.5&fp-y=0.5&dm=1758722839&s=3d8bbca5e2d932d5e196100d02bdd941)

- ### What happens if my contact list grows beyond my current plan’s limit—will I be penalized or locked out of features?







If your contact list grows beyond your current plan’s limit, ActiveCampaign makes it easy to upgrade to the next contact band or plan without penalties or losing access to features. You’ll never be locked out of your account or forced to pay unexpected fees—your investment simply scales as your business and opportunities expand.

- ### Are there any setup costs or hidden fees when starting with ActiveCampaign?







There are no setup costs or hidden fees when you start with ActiveCampaign. Every plan includes core features and support to help you launch quickly and confidently. You can get started on a trial plan right away, and move to a contract.

- ### How does ActiveCampaign help ensure you only pay for what you actually use, rather than bundling in unnecessary extras?







ActiveCampaign’s modular approach means you choose the plan and add-ons that fit your current needs, without being forced into bundles or paying for features you don’t use. As your business grows, you can add channels or advanced capabilities, ensuring your investment always matches your goals and usage.

- ### What are AI credits? Do all actions use credits?







AI credits are used when Active Intelligence completes an action outside of its core set of AI capabilities. This includes actions such as generating images, sending translated email campaigns, or leveraging advanced industry context & intelligence. Core AI capabilities include creating campaigns, automations, reports, contact import, and more. Currently, core AI capabilities are included as part of Active Intelligence and stay on even if your AI credits run out. For more information about AI Credits, please visit our [help page](https://help.activecampaign.com/hc/en-us/articles/31101726158492-AI-Credits-FAQs).

- ### Will I lose access to Active Intelligence if I run out of AI credits?







No. Active Intelligence and core AI capabilities keep working when your AI credits run out. Only advanced AI capabilities will pause until more AI credits are added. Proactive insights & recommendations automatically generated by the Active Intelligence system also may continue to run. For more information about AI Credits, please visit our [help page](https://help.activecampaign.com/hc/en-us/articles/31101726158492-AI-Credits-FAQs).

# ActiveCampaign Platform Demo in 4 Minutes!
### Transcript
Through our powerful automation technology, the addition of AI capabilities, including AI content generation, and the ability to seamlessly integrate with your favorite tools and platforms, you can maximize your team's efficiency and deliver exceptional results.

You can capture new leads and key information about them using forms built on ActiveCampaign. We have over 100 pre-designed landing page templates available to get you started fast, and to get people to that page, you can utilize our integrations with Facebook, Google, LinkedIn and a variety of other leading platforms and tools.

Contact profiles will show you data captured from the form, tags assigned, or lists subscribed to, updating automatically as that contact interacts with your business.

Our easy to use drag and drop email designer featuring our AI content generator allows you to craft beautiful, personalized messages within minutes.

Automatically follow up with new leads using automations to send one or multiple perfectly timed emails. Automatically add tags, update fields, or assign subscribers to different lists within automations. Trigger emails based on site activity, email engagement, integration actions, or any other event you're tracking.

And with our sales automation and CRM features, you can use automations to create new deals and track qualified leads throughout the sales cycle. Using ActiveCampaign CRM and sales engagement, you can notify your team when assigning deals and tasks and automatically send personalized one to one communications from deal owners to leads.

### Transcript

**00:00**

ActiveCampaign streamlines your marketing and sales efforts using automation, empowering you with the customer insights to create personalized experiences for your customers at scale. Through our powerful automation technology, the addition of AI capabilities, including AI content generation, and the ability to seamlessly integrate with your favorite tools and platforms, you can maximize your team's efficiency and deliver exceptional results. ActiveCampaign can be your home base for customer interaction and power your business's growth.

**00:39**

You can capture new leads and key information about them using forms built on ActiveCampaign. Then embed the form into your existing website, or add it to a landing page built directly in ActiveCampaign to introduce your business to potential leads by promoting your company, offering a promotion, or providing more in-depth information. We have over 100 pre-designed landing page templates available to get you started fast, and to get people to that page, you can utilize our integrations with Facebook, Google, LinkedIn and a variety of other leading platforms and tools.

**01:19**

Once a contact has submitted a form, keep track of them within ActiveCampaign. Contact profiles will show you data captured from the form, tags assigned, or lists subscribed to, updating automatically as that contact interacts with your business. Using site tracking, you can see and act on their interactions with your website. All of these data points make it easier for you to segment your audience and tailor content just for them.

**01:47**

Start communicating with these new contacts right away using cutting edge AI powered emails. Our easy to use drag and drop email designer featuring our AI content generator allows you to craft beautiful, personalized messages within minutes. Don't have time to start from scratch? Choose from one of our 250+ professionally designed templates. Then use the AI content generator to help draft up written content based on a text prompt or even a link to your website or blog article to have it summarized. Provide feedback on the tone or length of the generated content using a secondary prompt, then edit that content to ensure the messaging is right for your contacts.

**02:34**

Automatically follow up with new leads using automations to send one or multiple perfectly timed emails. Automatically add tags, update fields, or assign subscribers to different lists within automations. Trigger emails based on site activity, email engagement, integration actions, or any other event you're tracking.

**02:58**

And with our sales automation and CRM features, you can use automations to create new deals and track qualified leads throughout the sales cycle. Using ActiveCampaign CRM and sales engagement, you can notify your team when assigning deals and tasks and automatically send personalized one to one communications from deal owners to leads. Our detailed deal records ensure you or your team will always have the right information when talking with those leads.

**03:31**

So are you ready to boost your marketing and sales efforts? Join over 185,000 companies who choose ActiveCampaign to help grow their business. Start a free 14 day trial today!
